limitations: Three prospective developer-tool fixes, not representative product/UI timings or three independent SDD agents.
One controller; first recorded request is session-level, not task-level.
Test phase includes launcher, test execution and result polling; worker/test-run wall are separate and must not be added.
Uninstrumented preflight and measurement setup are excluded; the interrupted P4 journal and short P4-clock experiment are excluded from the three samples.
Zero waiting is an explicit observation of no external waiting, not a replacement for missing values.
Usage belongs to requests timestamped inside task windows, not a causal allocation of token costs.
No matched pre-change sample; no end-to-end speedup or statistical flake-rate claim.
Cache creation zero is the local recorded usage, not a billing assertion.
